newsitem.title: USA: Washington, Minnesota cleared for disaster aid.
newsitem.headline: Washington, Minnesota cleared for disaster aid.

text.p: President Clinton declared Tuesday that major disasters existed in Minnesota and Washington, making victims of ice storms in both states eligible for federal assistance.

The White House said a 12-county area in Minnesota hit by ice storms between Nov. 14 and Nov. 30 was affected by the president's action. They included Cottonwood, Faribault, Freeborn, Jackson, Lincoln, Lyon, Murray, Nobles, Pipestone, Rock, Waseca and Yellow Medicine.
Three counties in Washington that experienced ice storms between Nov. 19 and Dec. 4 -- Klickitat, Pend Oreille and Spokane -- were also affected, it said.
Clinton's action made federal disaster relief funds available to local governments and individuals in the affected to help them recover from storm damage.
